title: Usage dropped 40% after a prompt change
prompt: Runs are down and no error rate moved. What do you do first?

options.text: Treat declining usage as a friction signal, gather qualitative user input, and compare against the pre-change baseline.
options.feedback: Correct. Declining usage can indicate user friction or changing needs, and measurement pairs quantitative data with qualitative feedback.

options.text: Assume seasonality and wait a quarter.
options.feedback: No. That discards the signal the metric exists to give you.

options.text: Roll back every change without diagnosis.
options.feedback: Rolling back blind loses the learning, and insight from measurement is meant to feed back into planning.
